business_requirement.summary: Implement automated approval for low-risk screen damage claims to reduce manual processing time and improve customer experience.
business_requirement.user_story: As a claims processor, I want the system to automatically approve eligible screen damage claims so that customers receive faster resolutions and I can focus on complex cases.
acceptance_criteria: Claims under £250 for screen damage should be auto-approved if customer risk score is below 0.3
All decisions must be logged with full audit trail
System must integrate with existing Claims API

audit_requirements: Every decision must log: claim_id, customer_id (masked), decision, reason_code, timestamp
Decision pathway must be fully traceable
PII must never appear in logs
